Pooja vs State Of U.P. on 18 July, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:142108
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 26191 of 2023

Applicant :- Pooja
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Vivek Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

1. Heard Sri Vivek Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Rajeev Dhar Dwivedi,
learned Aga, for the State.

2.  The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release her on bail in Case Crime No.53 of 2023, under Sections 498A and 304-B IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Sarpataha, District Jaunpur during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and two others including the husband of the deceased and according to the FIR, marriage of the deceased was performed with the brother of applicant on 7.12.2021 and after marriage her husband and applicant and one another accused tortured her for demand of dowry and in the FIR it is specifically mentioned against the applicant that she tortured the deceased and it is further mentioned in the FIR that on 3.3.2023 due to torture by applicant and his family members, deceased hanged herself.

Pooja vs State Of U.P. on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176243110/
1

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is the married sister-in-law of the deceased and her marriage had already performed in the year 2019 and after marriage she resided in her matrimonial home and was having no concern with the family affairs of the deceased and she only being sister-in-law of deceased has been made accused in the present matter.
He further submits that due to some dispute with her husband, deceased committed suicide and post mortem report of deceased also suggests that she hanged herself.
5. He further submits that applicant in the present matter is in jail since 6.3.2023, i.e., for the last about more than 3 months.
6. Per contra, learned AGA although opposed the prayerfor bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant is the married sister-in-law of deceased and deceased died due to hanging.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

8. Although in the FIR it has been mentioned that applicant harassed the deceased but admittedly she is married sister-in-law of deceased and her marriage had been performed in the year 2019 and deceased died due to ante mortem hanging, therefore, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

10. Let the applicant-Pooja be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
11. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

12. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 18.7.2023 SKM  Pooja vs State Of U.P. on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176243110/
